Count what you record at the same time: two inputs cover a vocalist plus guitar, a drum kit needs eight or more. Streaming or podcasting? You need loopback. Claude and GPT choose the same product: Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 (4th Gen). https://1billionmodels.com/musical-instruments/music-recording-equipment/computer-recording-equipment/computer-recording-audio-interfaces?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice.
title: How many inputs does your audio interface need?
